name: Bedrock Signaling Proxy
author: ccarney@zyphi.co
description: A proxy service for a Nethernet enabled bedrock server utilizing traefik. This is to be used for generating and renewing SSL certificates.

installation.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

cd /mnt/server

if ! [ -f traefik.env ]; then
  echo "TRAEFIK_LOG_LEVEL=INFO" >> traefik.env
  echo "TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINTS_WEBSECURE_ADDRESS=:19132" >> traefik.env
  echo "TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINTS_WEBSECURE_HTTP_ALIASHEADERSSTRATEGY=delete" >> traefik.env
  echo "TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINTS_WEBSECURE_HTTP_TLS=true" >> traefik.env
  echo "TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINTS_WEBSECURE_HTTP_TLS_CERTRESOLVER=cloudflare" >> traefik.env
  echo "TRAEFIK_CERTIFICATESRESOLVERS_CLOUDFLARE_ACME_EMAIL=admin@example.com" >> traefik.env
  echo "TRAEFIK_CERTIFICATESRESOLVERS_CLOUDFLARE_ACME_STORAGE=acme.json" >> traefik.env
  echo "TRAEFIK_CERTIFICATESRESOLVERS_CLOUDFLARE_ACME_DNSCHALLENGE_PROVIDER=cloudflare" >> traefik.env
  echo "TRAEFIK_ACCESSLOG=true" >> traefik.env
  echo "TRAEFIK_PROVIDERS_FILE_DIRECTORY=file.d" >> traefik.env
  echo "" >> traefik.env
  echo "CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=abcxyz-replaceme" >> traefik.env
fi

if ! [ -d file.d ]; then
  mkdir file.d/
  echo "[http.routers.bedrock]" >> file.d/bedrock.toml
  echo "  rule = \"Host(\`*.example.com\`)\"" >> file.d/bedrock.toml
  echo "  service = \"bedrock\"" >> file.d/bedrock.toml
  echo "" >> file.d/bedrock.toml
  echo "[[http.services.bedrock.loadBalancer.servers]]" >> file.d/bedrock.toml
  echo "  url = \"http://localhost:19133\"" >> file.d/bedrock.toml
fi
